subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit log retention & evidence routes
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finnovate.com>, Maya Patel <security@finnovate.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-21T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit log retention & evidence routes

Tom / Maya — thanks again for taking 30 minutes today. Below is a concise recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can get you into a short security intake path and confirm whether Redwood is an operational fit. Please review and confirm anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared
- Audit log retention: need immutable audit logs for 13 months, with export for internal auditors.
- SOC 2 readiness: gap visibility required for May 2028 audit; you want a short list of artifacts we can provide now vs. later.
- Pen test requirements: FinNova requires vendor scoping and evidence that we accept a customer-initiated pen test or coordinate with our third-party assessor.
- DPA & retention clauses: legal needs clear retention/erasure language and a copy of any subprocessor list.

Goals from your side
- Confirm Redwood can provide exports of audit logs (S3 or secure share) and a retention policy mapping by 10/05/2027.
- Get an artifact matrix of SOC 2-relevant docs (diagram + where artifacts live) by 09/28/2027.
- Agree on a pen test window Q1 2028 and initial scope by 10/12/2027.

What Redwood will deliver (proposed owners & dates)
1) Evidence matrix (SOC 2 starter pack) — Rishi to assemble a one-page artifact map + binary list. Target: 2027-09-28.
2) Audit log export options + retention mapping (S3 presigned or secure share) — Ben to scope options and sample log schema. Target: 2027-10-05.
3) Pen test scope doc (what we allow, typical constraints, timeline) — Soojin will propose an initial scope doc. Target: 2027-10-12.
4) DPA redline checklist & subprocessor list — Ben to attach current DPA and list. Target: 2027-09-30.

Attachments included: SOC2-Summary-FinnovA-v1.pdf, Retention-Requirements-worksheet.xlsx, PenTest-Scope-proposed.docx (these are stubs — we can expand).

Immediate asks for you
- Maya: confirm whether FinNova requires 'immutable' logs (WORM) or whether a combination of signed/exported logs satisfies auditors.
- Janelle: who in procurement owns contract redlines (email + DocuSign contact) so we can route the DPA?

Next sync
- If this looks correct we'll set a 30-min follow-up for 10/06 to review the evidence matrix and retention options.

Thanks again — appreciate the clarity on timelines.

— Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
attachments: [SOC2-Summary-FinnovA-v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB), Retention-Requirements-worksheet.xlsx (XLSX, 80KB), PenTest-Scope-proposed.docx (DOCX, 35KB)]
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finnovate.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <security@finnovate.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-21T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit log retention & evidence routes

Soojin — thanks, that matches our notes. A couple clarifications:
- For audit logs we need tamper-evident exports (signed hashes are fine) rather than WORM storage in your environment.
- SOC 2 artifacts: prize list would be IAM diagrams, change-control evidence, access review cadence, and a recent vulnerability scan report.
- Pen test: we prefer to use our assessor (CrestPoint). We'll need your point of contact to coordinate rules of engagement; scope likely limited to infra/services used by FinNova.

Procurement: Janelle Brooks (cc'd) will own contract redlines. I'll loop Legal if anything unusual pops up.

Agree on the 10/06 follow-up; 10:00–10:30 PT works for our team.

— Tom
CTO, FinNova Payments
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finnovate.com>, Maya Patel <security@finnovate.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-22T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit log retention & evidence routes

Tom — perfect, appreciate the specifics. Quick confirmations and tiny changes to the timeline:
- Audit logs: Ben will include hash-signature export options plus an S3-to-customer-export workflow. Target remains 10/05.
- SOC2 artifacts: Rishi will include the four priority artifacts you listed in the starter pack.
- Pen test: we'll introduce our security eng lead (internal Rishi) to CrestPoint and craft ROE; propose we target two-week testing window in Q1 2028.

Janelle — can you share procurement contact email and preferred format for DPAs (redline vs. new draft)? If redline, we'll attach a versioned DPA by 09/30.

Action items (owners)
- Rishi: SOC2 starter pack (09/28) + intro to security lead for ROE (this week).
- Ben: audit log export options and DPA baseline (09/30 / 10/05).
- Soojin: schedule 10/06 follow-up and draft pen test scope (10/12).

I'll upload the artifact stub folder to Drive and share with the FinNova security group: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_FinNova-SOC2

Thanks — we look forward to partnering on this.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finnovate.com>, Maya Patel <security@finnovate.com>, Janelle Brooks <janelle.brooks@finnovate.com>
Date: 2027-09-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2, audit log retention & evidence routes

Soojin — I'll own the starter pack. Quick internal notes for transparency:
- I'll pull the latest IAM diagram (cloud architecture) and a short change-control playbook excerpt; both are straightforward.
- For vulnerability evidence, we have a quarterly scan report and a recent patching cadence report — will mark which are shareable.
- For pen test ROE: I'll lead the intro to CrestPoint and propose two constraints: (1) black-box only against customer-facing inference endpoints; (2) no synthetic workload injection without prior scheduling.

Ben — can you prepare two export patterns for audit logs: (A) scheduled signed-export to a customer S3 bucket; (B) ad-hoc signed-export via secure share (FTPS or SFTP). I will note the preferred fields FinNova asked for: timestamp, request-id, model-id, caller-subject, action, response-size.

I'll drop the SOC2 starter pack into the Drive folder today and ping Maya when it's live.

— Rishi
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
